prompt:
High-fidelity mobile UI design comp: one portrait phone screen filling the frame.

The app is Squirrel, a personal memory aid. This is its "chores" room, designed as a rail concourse split-flap departure board. Same world as a matte-black flap board in a brushed steel chassis — but here the rooms themselves are platforms, listed down a left gutter, so switching rooms happens on the board rather than on another screen.

STRUCTURE, left to right and top to bottom:
1. A slim brushed steel header rail with tiny wide-tracked uppercase monospace: "SQUIRREL" left, "PLATFORMS" right.
2. A NARROW LEFT GUTTER running the full height, about one fifth of the width: a vertical column of platform numbers in large cream monospace — 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — each with a tiny rotated uppercase room name beside it reading PILE, AGENDA, CHORES, TASKS, ASIDE. Platform 3 (CHORES) is the current one: its cell is filled bright orange (#e66d0d) with near-black numerals. Platforms 1 and 2 carry a small glowing amber lamp meaning something waits there; 4 and 5 are dark.
3. THE BOARD, filling the remaining width: six departure rows, denser and tighter than a typical board, each row a time column in cream monospace, a destination in condensed uppercase white paint on matte black flap cells, and a status column at the right in tiny monospace.
   Row 1, highlighted with a thin orange border: "NOW  WATER THE PLANTS  DUE".
   Row 2: "THU  BINS OUT  EVERY 2 WKS".
   Row 3: "SAT  RECYCLING  EVERY 2 WKS".
   Row 4, in dim red and struck through: "—  DESCALE KETTLE  CANCELLED".
   Row 5: "SUN  CHANGE FILTER  EVERY 90 DAYS".
   Row 6, in amber: "MON  BLEED RADIATORS  DELAYED".
4. A footer strip across the full width below the gutter and board: three action cells as flaps — bright orange (#e66d0d) "DID IT" in near-black monospace, then matte black "HOW OFTEN" and "STOP ASKING" in cream monospace.

MATERIALS: matte black flap faces, crisp white paint letters, brushed steel chassis and gutter, amber lamps, fine mechanical shadow between flaps.
STRICT PALETTE: #17130d #0c0a07 #241f19 #fffbf3 #fed6a7 #e66d0d #b03a1e.
TYPE: one condensed uppercase sans on the flaps in fixed character cells; tiny wide-tracked uppercase monospace for times, platform names, status and actions.
MOOD: a busy concourse board read at a glance — dense, ranked, unarguable. Every room is a platform on the same board.
